body:
incident-bot: PAGER — P1: widespread SSE disconnects + tool-call parsing failures observed in prod (multiple customers). Auto-created channel #incidents/1834001234. Please acknowledge and start mitigation. :rotating_light:
oncall-ml: ack I'm on it, paging infra/sre now. Taking lead for triage.
alex: seeing ~4-6% abort rate on stream connections from eu-west-1, spikes at 12:02UTC. Tool-call errors show JSON parse failures (unexpected EOF).
maria: confirmed, example logs attached below from prod-proxy-2: (truncated)
```
2026-03-15T12:02:04Z INFO incoming sse conn id=abc123 client=app-ios/3.4.2
2026-03-15T12:02:05Z ERROR toolcall parse id=abc123 err="unexpected end of JSON input"
2026-03-15T12:02:05Z WARN stream disconnected id=abc123 reason=EOF
```
jon: I pushed streaming parser change 9f4b2c at 11:58UTC (small buffer/flush tweak). Rolling that back now to 9f4b2b to test.
leah: interesting — iOS 3.4.2 clients send chunked bodies with keepalive pings, might interact with the parser change. Also saw Content-Length: 0 in a subset.
mike: oncall-sre here, joining handoff in 5m. any immediate mitigations?
oncall-ml: mitigation plan: 1) rollback parser to 9f4b2b (in progress), 2) enable server-side toolcall fallback (treat parse fail -> return 502 with retry-after header) for affected clusters, 3) enable TCP keepalive tuning to lower idle. Rolling 1 now.
alex: rollback deployed to eu-west-1 canary shard, monitoring.
maria: telemetry shows tool-call error rate dropped to baseline on canary after rollback. pushing to remainder if stable.
customer-success-bot: noticed impacted accounts — CS alerted enterprise accounts with temporary mitigation note. No billing impact reported yet.
sre-bot: scaling event at 12:01:45UTC in prod-autoscale group caused burst of reconnects, correlating with parser change window.
jon: I have logs and git diff for the parser change: https://internal.git/changes/9f4b2c (private). Key change was flush-on-chunk=true by default.
leah: hypothesis A: flush-on-chunk caused partial JSON bodies to be presented to parser before final chunk; parser expected full object and returned EOF. Hypothesis B: certain clients (iOS 3.4.2) send keepalive CRLF that the parser treats as end-of-stream.
alex: reproducer (local):
```
# simulate SSE with chunked toolcall
printf "event: tool\ndata: {\"id\":\"x\",\"payload\":\"hi" | nc -q1 localhost 8080
```
jon: added deeper logs around chunk boundaries and parser state. Sharing sample traces: trace-id=tr-98765 (see logs).
mike: bookkeeping: paging notes updated, ops taking ownership of rollout. i'll coordinate postmortem and assign RCA lead.
oncall-ml: next steps in-thread: 1) finish rollback across regions (in progress), 2) collect timeline of deploys, autoscale events, and customer errors, 3) gather representative packet captures and parser traces, 4) validate client versions calling in.
maria: collecting timeline: deploy 9f4b2c @11:58UTC, autoscale burst @12:01:45UTC, error spike 12:02–12:10UTC, rollback canary @12:06UTC, rollback full @12:12UTC, error rates normalized @12:16UTC.
leah: capturing suspect client headers (anonymized):
```
User-Agent: app-ios/3.4.2
Connection: keep-alive
Transfer-Encoding: chunked
```
alex: quick mitigation for affected customers: enable `streaming_parser_strict=false` on per-tenant config to accept partial chunks and buffer until end; this patched a couple of accounts with heavy iOS traffic.
jon: we should also add try/catch around parse and log partial payload to S3 for postmortem (sanitized). I'll open a PR for safe logging.
mike: assigning RCA: jon (lead), leah (client interaction), alex (telemetry), maria (timeline), me (postmortem doc + followups).
customer-success-bot: CS will send post-incident note to impacted customers by EOD with temporary workaround + ETA for permanent fix.
sre-bot: action item created: #INC-9342 increase SSE keepalive timeout and add parser resilience tests to CI.
oncall-ml: final immediate note: rollback + per-tenant lax mode + TCP keepalive tuned reduced errors to baseline. We'll keep channel open for RCA timeline updates and add logs/traces to the ticket.
mike: handing over to morning oncall at 13:00UTC. If anything regresses, @pager escalate.
jon: creating RCA draft in docs/internal/rca/1834001234.md and will paste timeline + hypothesis matrix here once done.
leah: preliminary root cause: parser change + client chunking/keepalive interaction causing partial payloads to be parsed too early. Confirmed by rollback and canary.
alex: postmortem action: add explicit chunk-aggregation in parser and CI tests for chunked transfer encodings (include iOS client fiddles).
customer-success-bot: incident severity downgraded to mitigated at 12:16UTC; monitoring. Will mark P1->P2 after RCA draft. :white_check_mark:
